name: Maxine Waters

items.text: The House Ethics Committee examined whether Waters improperly helped OneUnited Bank, where her husband held stock. On September 21, 2012, it voted 10-0 that the evidence did not establish a violation by her. It found her chief of staff acted for the bank despite her instructions to avoid the conflict, and reproved him.
items.why: The conflict-of-interest charge bears on not using office for self-dealing (criterion 6), but the Committee found no violation by Waters, so there is no finding against her own conduct.

items.text: On April 17, 2021, at a Minnesota protest, Waters said that if Derek Chauvin weren't convicted, protesters should "get more confrontational." The trial judge denied a mistrial but called officials' failure to respect the court "abhorrent." A censure resolution failed. Waters said she meant confronting the justice system and nonviolent action.
items.why: The remarks are on the record in her own words and drew a judge's rebuke, but there is no finding of wrongdoing and no clear link to any criterion, such as abuse of office.

items.text: At a June 23, 2018 Los Angeles rally, Waters told supporters to "create a crowd" and push back on Trump Cabinet officials they met in public places. She later said she believes in peaceful protest and had not called for harm to anyone.
items.why: This is rally rhetoric criticized by opponents and some Democrats, with no official finding and no conduct tied to any criterion, such as abuse of office.

for_review: Item 1: I read the Committee's 2012 statement but not the full report or Waters' own response. I did not verify the 2010 charge date or her bias allegation from primary records. Item 2: I could not confirm the 216-210 censure vote count from a page I read. I read only PolitiFact's report that the censure failed on party lines. Item 3: Waters' rally remarks are in her own words, and PolitiFact reports that she denied calling for harm. No official action was found. The owner-site search turned up only a 2018 Infowars post about the rally remarks, which I did not rely on. Attendance and AIPAC matters were not weighed. I found no other against or open items, but I did not search for other controversies.
